summary: Review payroll, equity, and cross-border compensation tax issues with practical controls. Explore the five-day advanced course and syllabus.
lede: Employee compensation tax and legal training helps payroll, tax, HR, and legal professionals review pay arrangements and supporting records. It covers classifying compensation, reviewing withholding and payroll reconciliations, assessing employee benefits under IAS 19 and share-based awards under IFRS 2, and mapping cross-border treaty issues using the OECD Model Tax Convention. Participants also practise building review checklists, tracking exceptions, and designing controls and audit trails.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who review employee pay, benefits, payroll obligations, or compensation governance across teams and locations.
modules: OECD Model Tax Convention and Compensation
Cross-Border Pay and OECD Transfer Pricing
Employment Records and ILO Convention No. 95
prerequisites: Advanced-level course. Prior professional experience in payroll, employee tax, compensation and benefits, international tax, employment law, or related finance and HR operations is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring familiarity with your organization’s compensation and payroll processes; review of local law remains the responsibility of appropriately qualified advisers.
